about.whoWeAreDesc: Welcome to Association of Business Women in Commerce & Industry (ABWCI) — one virtual global chamber for women entrepreneurs. We dey empower and celebrate women business sense and ambition by connect our members with industry leaders, professional development resources, and the right opportunities. We be community wey get top women entrepreneurs, schools and companies wey dey invest for women. Our goal na to empower and support women for business through global networking platform. For ABWCI, we sabi and value the important role wey women entrepreneurs dey play for economic growth and job creation. We dey work to create world wey women go face less wahala for access to funding, government rules, business education and more. For ABWCI, we dey re‑define networking and we dey invite you make you join this community of committed, passionate, successful and influential women for business! We dey here to help your business grow and prosper.
about.ourVisionDesc: We wan make world wey every woman fit get chance to be leader, do new thing and succeed for trade/work. We dey look future wey women fit get everything dem need to drive their business kampe and dey contribute for big economy work.
about.ourMissionDesc: We wan power women for business with everything: mentorship, network, how to build, make policy work for equality and help dem knock down any wahala. We dey push for place wey women fit get money, grow their work and make the place sweet for everybody.
